idea-plugin.name: ReScript
idea-plugin.description:
ReScript Language Support for JetBrains IDEs

Comprehensive language support for ReScript (.res, .resi files), powered by a hybrid architecture: a built-in JFlex lexer for fast syntax highlighting and the @rescript/language-server (LSP) for semantic analysis.

Language Support

  • Syntax highlighting with JFlex lexer + LSP semantic tokens
  • Code folding (blocks, comments, custom //#region markers)
  • Brace matching, smart quotes, breadcrumb navigation
  • Structure view and navigation bar
  • Spell checking with bundled ReScript dictionary

Code Intelligence

  • Code completion with context-based ranking
  • Go to Definition, Find Usages, Find References
  • Hover documentation, Signature Help, Parameter Info
  • Inlay hints and Code Lens (inferred type annotations)
  • Rename, Extract Variable/Function, Inline, Change Signature
  • Search Everywhere with stub-indexed symbols (Shift+Shift)
  • Type signature search (reverse function lookup)

Code Analysis

  • Error Lens — inline diagnostics with type mismatch diff highlighting
  • Inspections: duplicate open, empty module, signature sync, style linting
  • Dead code analysis via reanalyze (with server-mode acceleration)
  • Format check with quick-fix auto-formatting

Editing

  • 20+ Intention Actions (wrap, unwrap, pipe conversion, case split, etc.)
  • Surround With (if/switch/try/block), Postfix Completion (.switch, .pipe, .log)
  • 21 Live Templates, Generate actions (switch arms, JSON encoder/decoder, etc.)
  • JSX auto-close, smart Enter/Join, statement mover

Build & Run

  • Run configuration with gutter icons, test runner (Jest/Vitest)
  • JavaScript debugger integration, compiled JS preview
  • REPL, Worksheet mode (.resw), Scratch files

Project Integration

  • Project Wizard with 16 templates (Basic, Vite+React, Next.js, Electron, etc.)
  • One-click LSP auto-install with package manager detection
  • Project View nesting (.resi under .res, compiled JS nested and grayed)
  • .d.ts → ReScript binding generation, dependency diagram
  • rescript.json JSON Schema with auto-completion and validation

Requirements

  • Node.js 18 LTS or later, available in PATH
  • @rescript/language-server 1.0.0+ installed in project or globally (compatible with ReScript 11+; the bundled installer always pulls the latest stable)

0.1.16.1

Infrastructure

0.1.16

  • IntelliJ Platform 2026.2 EAP compatibility — migrated the navigation bar to AbstractNavBarModelExtension, replaced 2026.2-internal plugin-descriptor lookups with a build-generated version resource, and passed an explicit timeout to sendRequestSync so the plugin loads cleanly on 2026.2 EAP
  • Suppressed a deprecation warning on the FileIncludeProvider.acceptFile override surfaced by plugin verification on 2026.2

Infrastructure

  • Adopted verifier-cli 1.405 and restored recommended() verification IDEs (2025.3 / 2026.1 / 2026.2 EAP)

0.1.15

New Features

  • Colour-coded diagram semantics — Variant Flow arms (constructor / wildcard / binding / todo / nested), Module Dependency node roles (entry / intermediate / leaf / cycle), Interop Risk severity bands, and Type Impact reference kinds each get a Light/Dark-aware palette with legends

Bug Fixes

  • Module Dependency diagram building and Type Impact reference resolution moved off the UI thread, keeping the IDE responsive on large projects
  • Type Info and PPX panels no longer react to caret movement in other open projects
  • Project templates raise vulnerable dependency floors: Next.js to ^16.2.9 (GHSA-26hh-7cqf-hhc6) and concurrently to ^10.0.3 (shell-quote advisory)
  • Added missing intention description resources flagged by plugin verification

Refactoring

  • Tool window panels share a common scaffold (toolbar, status bar, debounced refresh) and the debounce now uses platform coroutines instead of the internal Alarm API
  • Wizard templates generate through a shared frame, guarded by golden characterization tests covering all 22 templates across 74 configuration combos

Infrastructure

  • IntelliJ Platform 2026.1.2; project templates move to Expo SDK 56
  • Template npm versions are audited monthly against the npm advisory database
